# The Social Vision

> The Social Vision (TSV) is a London-based short-form content agency. We plan, cast, film, edit and post TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts content for apps and consumer brands, covering organic content and paid ad creative.

- Founder: Zahira Jaigirdar, Founder & Creative Director
- Based in: London, United Kingdom. Works with brands across the UK.
- Organic formats: street interview content, organic social productions, creator-led organic
- Paid formats: paid social productions, remote creator UGC
- Platforms: TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. We work in English only.
- What we don’t do: influencer marketing or influencer campaigns, and we don’t offer edit-only work. We make UGC and short-form content with our creators, for the client’s own channels.
- Creator network: 300+ vetted UK creators
- Who we work with: consumer apps, fintech, edtech and student brands, food and drink, health and consumer brands. Clients include Plum, Habito, Uni Compare, TALAB, Blackbullion, Applicaa and Prep Kitchen.
- Pricing: monthly retainers scoped to each brand's goals, formats and content volume, on a 3-month initial term, then rolling with 30 days' notice
- First content live: within 14–21 days of signing
- Organic minimum: 16 videos a month. The paid minimum depends on the budget.
- Creator pay: creators are paid on the 15th of the month
- Revisions: included. The number of rounds is agreed in each brief. If our footage is not good enough, we reshoot at our own cost. A reshoot after a client script change is quoted case by case. Extra work is quoted per project.
- Usage: perpetual usage rights on the content we make, including running it as ads from the brand's own account. Creator-handle Spark Ads, whitelisting and partnership ads, which run under the creator's name, need a separate written agreement and creator authorisation.
- Scripts are the default. Talking points are used only if the brief says so.
- High-production and street-interview shoots need 1 week’s notice.
- Shipping: the client ships the product at their cost, and the creator keeps it.
- Regulated brands: nothing goes live until compliance signs off.

## Results

- [Habito](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/case-studies/habito) (digital mortgage broker): 25M+ organic views in 8 months with zero ad spend, average views per video up from about 1,000 to 156,000
- [Uni Compare](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/case-studies/uni-compare) (university comparison platform): 1M+ views in the first 8 weeks, average views per video up from under 1,000 to 83,000
- [TALAB](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/case-studies/talab) (student app): from launch with no audience to 6,000 users, organic short-form content driving most of that growth
- [Plum](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/case-studies/plum) (money app): a dedicated paid social creative partner producing Paid Social Productions and Remote Creator UGC

## Guides

- [How to Market to University Students on TikTok](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/how-to-market-to-university-students): Students scroll past anything that looks like an ad. What works on TikTok, Reels and Shorts: real students on camera, shareable lists and the student calendar.
- [How to Make UGC Ads That Don't Look Like Ads](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/ugc-ads-that-dont-look-like-ads): Why most UGC ads blur together, and how to fix it: hooks that change by type, framing your audience recognises, and delivery that feels like a FaceTime.
- [Your Founder Doesn't Want to Be on Camera. Here's What Works Instead](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/social-content-without-founder-on-camera): No founder on camera? Creator-led organic puts one consistent creator in front of your audience, in a series they recognise. How it works.
- [How Often Should You Refresh Paid Social Creative?](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/paid-social-creative-refresh): Brands spending steadily on Meta and TikTok often need new ads every one to two weeks. How to plan creative so refreshes land on time.
- [Lo-Fi vs High Production Video: Which Works Better on Social?](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/lo-fi-vs-high-production-video): Lo-fi or polished? Why native-looking content usually wins on organic, where production earns its keep, and how to settle the debate with data.
- [Does AI-Generated Video Work on TikTok?](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/ai-generated-video-tiktok): AI makes video cheap to produce at scale. Why human-led content still wins on TikTok, Reels and Shorts, and where AI tools can genuinely help.
- [Who Comes Up With the Ideas? How Working With a Short-Form Content Agency Works](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/working-with-a-short-form-content-agency): Who comes up with the ideas, what your team signs off and how the first month runs when you work with a short-form content agency.
- [Organic vs Paid Social: How to Put Ad Spend Behind Content That Already Works](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/organic-vs-paid-social): Organic finds what works, paid scales it. How in-house teams run both, and the usage rights you need to put ad spend behind organic content.
- [How to Choose a Short-Form Content Agency in London](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/how-to-choose-a-short-form-content-agency): What different kinds of agency do, the questions to ask before you sign, the red flags, and how to tell whether an agency fits a brand like yours.
- [The 70/20/10 Rule: How We Decide What Content to Make Next](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/70-20-10-content-rule): The 70/20/10 rule for social media content: 70% proven formats, 20% what you talk about, 10% new formats. How we use it to decide what to make next.
- [Views Are Vanity. Shares Are the Algorithm.](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/shares-beat-views): Views are the result, not the goal. Retention and shares decide how far a short-form video travels. Why shares matter most, and what makes people send one.
- [How a Street Interview Shoot Actually Works](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/how-a-street-interview-shoot-works): A street interview shoot day, step by step: questions and cue cards, casting, locations, consent on camera and the edit. The process behind the videos.
- [Street Interview Marketing: The Complete Guide for UK Brands](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/street-interview-marketing-uk): Why street interviews keep working on TikTok, Reels and Shorts, and what UK brands need to know to plan, film and run them well.
- [Organic Short-Form Growth With Zero Ad Spend: What Actually Works in 2026](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/organic-tiktok-growth-zero-ad-spend): You don't need ad spend to grow on TikTok. You need a system. What actually drives organic growth in 2026, and what used to work but no longer does.
- [TikTok for Food and Drink Brands: What Converts in 2026](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/tiktok-food-drink-brands): Nobody can taste through a screen. How the food and drink brands winning on TikTok make people want something they can't try yet.
- [Stuck on 300 Views? Why Your Short-Form Videos Stall (And How to Fix It)](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/stuck-on-300-views): TikToks, YouTube Shorts or Reels stuck at around 300 views? The platform tested your video on a small group and stopped there. Here's why, and how to fix it.
- [Why Health & Wellness Brands Are Winning on TikTok (And What They're Doing Differently)](https://www.thesocialvision.co.uk/blog/health-wellness-tiktok-strategy): Wellness brands on TikTok have a trust problem. The ones winning solve it not with better claims, but by understanding how trust actually forms.
